title: finding(gates): `check-empty-changeset` and `Check Changeset` route 2 still say a `skills/**`-only PR releases nothing, so it passes with no changeset; since #22658 `@objectstack/skills` publishes `skills/**`
body:
Filing gate **①**, class (b): one rule, two texts that disagree. AGENTS.md's post-task checklist (`AGENTS.md:1085` on `origin/main` `61b12584f`) gives a `skills/**` change a **`patch`** changeset, "never `skip-changeset`". The changeset gate still teaches the opposite, from before `@objectstack/skills` existed:

- `scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs:513`, in the remedy it prints: "It releases nothing (.github/, .claude/, skills/, docs/, content/, examples/, …".
- The same file's self-test `GREEN 3: a skills/**-only PR carrying NO changeset (route 2)` (`:913-923`) asserts that such a PR "must be green here".
- `.github/workflows/pr-automation.yml` route 2's prose rests on the same premise.

Since #22658 (ruling A on #22649), `packages/skills` publishes `skills/**` (`files: [dist, README.md, CHANGELOG.md]`, built by `scripts/sync-catalog.mjs`, version `18.0.0-next.0`, in the fixed group). So a `skills/**`-only PR with no changeset ships text that the `@objectstack/skills` CHANGELOG never mentions.

`reach:` a named instance. PR #23443 (card #23268) deletes a row of `skills/objectstack-data/references/lint-rules.md`. The seat labelled it `skip-changeset` on the reading "docs/governed text only, no package", and `Check Changeset` reported `skipped` on head `ce509e82c`. Only the contract review caught it (record on PR #23443, ②). The label was removed and a `patch` changeset is being added; the gate itself would have passed the PR.

Filed by `domain:spec` seat 3 (#18883) · `baozhoutao` · session `session_01D6F9axfoPzR7t8G1J7Ytzz`, at PR #23443's review. ⛔ Not a claim; grading and routing are triage's.

**Reader who acts:** the seat that owns the changeset gate (`scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs`, `.github/workflows/pr-automation.yml`); triage routes it. The fix aligns the gate's route-2 text and its `GREEN 3` fixture with AGENTS.md (a `skills/**` change owes a `@objectstack/skills` changeset). Whether the gate should also refuse a `skills/**` diff carrying no changeset is that seat's call; it changes no other route.

## Re-check

- `git grep -n "skills/" origin/main -- scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs` → the remedy line (`:513`) and the `GREEN 3` battery (`:913-923`).
- Control: `git show origin/main:packages/skills/package.json` → `"files": ["dist", "README.md", "CHANGELOG.md"]`, and the build is `sync-catalog.mjs`.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on this repo, closed included:
- `check-empty-changeset skills only PR no changeset green @objectstack/skills published route 2 stale` → 0 hits.
- `skills changeset skip-changeset published skills package CHANGELOG` → 40 hits. The top ten are adjacent and closed: #22658 / #22649 / #22668 (the package's ruling and docs), #23276, #23275, #23251, #17311, #14794, #22970, #23176. None is this gate.

Dedupe words: check-empty-changeset route 2 skills/** stale premise; GREEN 3 skills-only no changeset; @objectstack/skills changeset owed.
